C1.name: line_haul_travel_time
C1.label: Line-haul travel time uncertainty
C1.operational_meaning: Realized movement time on rail, road and water main-haul arcs deviates from the planned travel time.

C2.name: border_processing_time
C2.label: Border processing and break-of-gauge time uncertainty
C2.operational_meaning: Customs, inspection, break-of-gauge handling and queueing at border nodes vary during execution.

C3.name: terminal_transshipment_time
C3.label: Terminal/transshipment handling time uncertainty
C3.operational_meaning: Handling and transfer processing time at terminals, ports and hubs varies during execution.

C4.name: capacity_slot_availability
C4.label: Service capacity and slot availability uncertainty
C4.operational_meaning: Short-term available capacity on links, nodes, services, slots or wagons is lower than planned.

C5.name: shipment_volume
C5.label: Shipment volume uncertainty
C5.operational_meaning: Execution-stage batch quantities or short-term OD shipment volumes deviate from the planned quantities.

C6.name: corridor_link_node_disruption
C6.label: Corridor/link/node disruption uncertainty
C6.operational_meaning: A recurrent operational disruption temporarily reduces the availability of key corridors, links, border nodes or terminals.
